---
title: "Preserving annual report results"
toc: true
---

**Proposal, not an implemented storage policy.** The annual data folders and `data/FY2025 Files/Archived/` already preserve some output. The remaining need is to identify exactly what supported each published report, while allowing the live site to improve.

## Keep published results separate from later revisions

Preserve two explicitly named products: **as published** (the data and method used for a particular edition) and **restated** (an older fiscal year recalculated using a later method or data delivery). A newer file should never silently replace the as-published record. A report about FY2024 may be published in 2025 and contain estimates for every year since 1998.

A practical approach is a small archive index in Git and a frozen bundle for each release. Hosting those bundles on GitHub Releases or an institutional repository is a choice still to be made. No external archive or release was created in this documentation update.

Suggested bundle layout:

```text
report-id/run-id/
  manifest.yml
  report/             # final PDF, citation, original URL
  source/             # exact R/Quarto code and lookup workbooks
  inputs/             # delivered data, or immutable references plus hashes
  output/             # summary workbook, machine-readable totals, figures
  site/               # rendered pages and assets for this run, if retained
  validation/         # report-to-output comparison and explanation of differences
  environment/        # R sessionInfo(), package versions, Quarto version
```

The `source` snapshot is particularly important if a run used uncommitted edits. A Git commit alone does not capture those edits or untracked inputs. Hashes identify exact files; they do not explain the method, so preserve both hashes and a narrative.

## Manifest template

Copy this template when an actual report bundle is assembled. `null` means not yet established, not zero or not applicable.

```yaml
report_id: null
title: null
fiscal_year: null
publication_date: null
edition: null                 # original, corrected, or restated
run_id: null
run_date: null
report_url: null
report_sha256: null
repository_url: null
source_commit: null
working_tree_changes: null   # saved patch/source snapshot, or confirmed clean
calculation_entrypoint: null # identify pension variant explicitly
data_coverage: null
data_received_date: null
data_status: null            # preliminary/final; distinguish revenue/expenditure
input_and_lookup_hashes: null
methodology:
  debt: null                 # include object 8800 qualification
  refunds: null              # fund flags, deductions, rebate treatment
  healthcare: null           # duplicate contributions and employee premiums
  pensions: null             # included objects and presentation
  local_transfers: null
  pandemic_funds: null       # receipts, expenditures, scenario scope
units: null
gap_definition: revenue_minus_expenditure
rounding: null
output_files_and_hashes: null
report_tables_verified: null
unresolved_differences: null
supersedes: null
```

## Reconciliation record

For each report table, retain fiscal year, category, printed value, computed unrounded value, units, difference, and explanation. Check that categories sum to totals and that revenue minus expenditure equals the fiscal gap. Compare at the report's rounding precision, retaining unrounded values in the bundle.

For revised historical series, explain differences in separate steps: source-data revisions; fund-frame changes; debt/refund/healthcare/pension rules; pandemic scenarios; and category reallocations. A reallocation should reconcile to zero change in aggregate spending unless included records also changed.

| FY2025 revenue report | PDF supplied locally; January 2026, pre-lapse-period report with $118.16B total revenue | Revenue-only publication; it is not a full fiscal-gap result |
| FY2025 expenditures report | PDF supplied locally; final-tallies companion report with $119.51B expenditures, $118.16B revenue, and a -$1.35B fiscal gap | As-published full fiscal-gap anchor identified; preserve its CURE/ESSER timing and refund-fund notes |
| FY2026 forthcoming publication | Four supplied output workbooks in `Fiscal Futures FY2026/outputs/`: two Data Hub workbooks and two summary workbooks, each with `pensions_separate` or `pensions_with_agencies` in the filename | Treat as the forthcoming-publication record. Preserve both named pension presentations, record the selected presentation in the release manifest, and retain the output filenames and data vintage alongside the published report |

When inventorying annual repositories, retain each original URL, fiscal-year scope, report citation, relevant commit, and a list of unique files. Link redundant content to the consolidated guide; avoid deleting older repositories until their unique evidence has been preserved and mapped.
